name: delete_vault_file
description:
Moves a vault file or artifact to the vault's Trash. It can be restored with restore_vault_file until the vault's Trash time runs out. Delete folders with delete_vault_folder.

Search keywords: delete vault file, trash vault file, delete vault artifact.

surfaceId.description: The vault Surface's ID, from list_surfaces. Must satisfy the required format.

path.description: The file to delete. Must satisfy the required format.
